title: OkrNode
description: One node in the OKR tree. Nodes are flat and carry a parent pointer; the tree is reconstructed from those pointers, never from nesting.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. New ids should read as "kr-<short-slug>" or "obj-<short-slug>".

level.description: Where the node sits in the ladder: company (the single root), objective (team-level), or kr (key result).

parent.description: Id of the parent node, or null for the company root. Exactly one node in a tree has a null parent.

label.description: What the node is trying to achieve, stated as an outcome rather than an activity. One sentence.

owner.description: Team or person accountable for this node, as display text, for example "Growth" or "Sales Ops". When unitId is set this is derived from that team's name; set unitId and leave owner alone.

unitId.description: Id of the owning team in company.units, or null when the node is not assigned to a team. owner is the display name derived from it.

metric.description: The quantity being moved, named precisely enough to be looked up. Empty means the node is not measurable.

target.description: The move being committed to, with a baseline, a goal, and a date, for example "31% -> 50% by Q4".

contributes.description: Hand-assessed score (0-1) of how well this node supports its parent. Anything below 0.4 is a misalignment worth calling out.
